description: This file defines models and a data fetcher for the Federal Reserve SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate). It includes data classes with normalization, a specialized query parameter class, and an asynchronous fetcher that retrieves SOFR data from the NY Fed API, processes the response, and converts it into model instances.

classes.name: FederalReserveSOFRQueryParams
classes.description: Extends SOFRQueryParams to specify query parameters for the Federal Reserve.

classes.name: FederalReserveSOFRData
classes.description: Represents the fetched SOFR data with alias mapping and a normalization method for percentage fields.

classes.name: FederalReserveSOFRFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching SOFR data from the NY Fed API asynchronously, transforming request parameters, and processing the data into model instances.

methods.name: normalize_percent(cls, v)
methods.description: Class method that normalizes percentage string or numeric values into float.

methods.name: FederalReserveSOFRQueryParams transform_query(params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms generic parameters into a specialized query object, setting default date ranges if not provided.

methods.name: List[Dict] aextract_data( query: FederalReserveSOFRQueryParams, credentials: Optional[Dict[str, str]], **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the NY Fed API, raises an error if no data is returned.

methods.name: List[FederalReserveSOFRData] transform_data( query: FederalReserveSOFRQueryParams, data: List[Dict], **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into a list of FederalReserveSOFRData instances, removing unwanted fields.

ctags.name: aextract_data
ctags.signature: ( query: FederalReserveSOFRQueryParams, credentials: Optional[Dict[str, str]], **kwargs: Any, )
